editorial_policy: Published cultural and historical introductions; not clinical advice. Date anchors distinguish historical documentation, institutional milestones and heritage recognition. Coordinates are approximate regional navigation points, never proof of origin. Full research-index and story-shell counts are not publication counts.

zh.title: 尼罗河畔，一卷纸草留下的照护世界
zh.hook: 在印刷书出现之前，人们已经把药物和身体经验写进长卷。
zh.date_note: 采用莱比锡大学图书馆所述的约略年代；不是一项疗法的发明年份。
story: 从尼罗河畔开始这段旅程。《埃伯斯纸草书》把治疗知识留在一卷长长的纸草上，让今天的读者得以接近古埃及人理解身体的方式。
这不是一本可以照着开药的现代手册，而是一份历史见证。看这些记录时，值得问的是：当时怎样描述问题？怎样组织知识？哪些解释后来发生了变化？

en.title: A world of care on a papyrus scroll
en.hook: Long before printed books, knowledge about bodies and remedies travelled on papyrus.
en.date_note: An approximate manuscript date reported by Leipzig University Library, not the invention date of a treatment.
story: The Ebers Papyrus opens a window onto ancient Egyptian knowledge about care and the body. Its long scroll preserves a way of organizing remedies before the age of printed medical books.
Read it as historical evidence, not a modern prescription book. The interesting journey is through how people described problems, arranged knowledge and understood their world.

zh.title: Jamu：一杯草本饮品背后的社区
zh.place: 印度尼西亚 · 爪哇地区
zh.hook: 从种植者到制作者，草本知识在人与人的信任中流动。
zh.date: 8世纪的传统线索 · 2023年列入非遗
zh.date_note: 8世纪依据 UNESCO 的传统史叙述；地图点代表爪哇地区，不主张唯一发源地。
story: Jamu 不只指某一种配方，也是一套围绕草本饮品的制作、交流和照护文化。当地植物与香料经过制作者的经验判断，进入日常生活。
UNESCO 的介绍强调女性制作者、家族传授，以及生产者和消费者之间的联系。看懂 Jamu，可以从认识这些人开始，而不是先背一份材料表。

en.title: Jamu: a community inside a cup
en.hook: Herbal knowledge travels through growers, makers and personal trust.
en.date_note: The historical range follows UNESCO's account. The Java pin is representative, not a unique birthplace.
story: Jamu is more than a single recipe. It is a culture of making, sharing and using preparations from local plants and spices in everyday life.
UNESCO highlights women makers, family transmission and relationships between producers and consumers. Begin with these people, rather than a list of ingredients.

zh.title: 格拉斯：花园如何走进一瓶香水
zh.place: 法国 · 格拉斯与普罗旺斯
zh.hook: 种花、处理香材、调香，是同一个故事的三个章节。
zh.date: 至少16世纪已有实践 · 2018年列入非遗
zh.date_note: 16世纪是法国文化部描述的实践年代范围；2018年是非遗认可年份，两者不可混用。
story: 走进格拉斯，先看田里的花，再看工坊里的原料，最后才看香水瓶。这里的香水技艺把植物栽培、天然原料处理与香气创作连接起来。
法国文化部记述这些知识至少自16世纪便在当地实践。2018年的国际非遗认可，保护的是这条由种植者、原料处理者和调香者共同传递的技艺链。香水工艺史与现代芳香疗法的疗效研究，是不同的问题。

en.title: Grasse: from a garden to a perfume
en.hook: Growing flowers, processing materials and composing scent form three chapters of one story.
en.date: Practised since at least the 16th century · inscription 2018
en.date_note: The practice range follows France's Ministry of Culture. UNESCO recognition in 2018 is not its origin date.
story: Start in the flower field, continue into the workshop and only then look at the bottle. Grasse's perfume skills connect cultivation, natural-material processing and fragrance composition.

France's Ministry of Culture traces these practices to at least the sixteenth century. Their 2018 heritage recognition concerns a living chain of knowledge. Perfumery history and evidence for clinical aromatherapy remain different subjects.

zh.title: Gnawa：音乐、记忆与仪式相遇
zh.place: 摩洛哥 · 以索维拉为导览点
zh.hook: 这里的声音不是一个 Hz 数值，而是社区的历史与共同经验。
zh.date: 至少16世纪的历史根源 · 2019年列入非遗
zh.date_note: 年代对应 UNESCO 对历史根源的描述；索维拉是区域导览点，不是唯一发源地。
story: 理解 Gnawa，需要同时听见音乐与它承载的历史。UNESCO 将它描述为音乐、表演、兄弟会实践与治疗性仪式交织的传统，其历史与奴隶贸易和受奴役群体有关。
因此，不宜把这套传统缩成一段可以复制的“疗愈频率”。仪式中的治疗意义属于其文化语境，不能直接改写成某个音高已被证明能够治病。

en.title: Gnawa: where sound meets memory
en.hook: Sound here carries community history, not just a frequency in hertz.
en.date: Roots dating to at least the 16th century · inscription 2019
en.date_note: The range follows UNESCO's historical account. Essaouira is a representative navigation point.
story: Gnawa combines music, performance, brotherhood practices and therapeutic ritual. UNESCO connects its historical roots with the slave trade and communities that experienced enslavement.
Reducing it to a downloadable healing frequency loses that context. A ritual's therapeutic meaning is not evidence that a particular pitch treats disease.

zh.title: 帕多瓦：把药用植物种成一间课堂
zh.place: 意大利 · 帕多瓦植物园
zh.hook: 一座花园，也可以是辨认植物与交换知识的地方。
zh.date_note: 确切年份指植物园建立，不是植物药传统的起源。
story: 1545年，帕多瓦植物园建立。它把植物收集、观察与教学放进同一片土地，让药用植物不只存在于文字和药柜里。
UNESCO 强调它在植物学、医学及植物交流中的历史作用。今天沿着园中的路径阅读，便能理解：一株植物如何从地方经验走入更广阔的知识网络。

en.title: Padua: a garden becomes a classroom
en.hook: A garden can be a place to identify plants and exchange knowledge.
en.date_note: This is the institution's founding year, not the origin of herbal medicine.
story: Founded in 1545, Padua's botanical garden brought collecting, observation and teaching onto the same ground. Medicinal plants could be studied alive rather than only in texts or cabinets.
UNESCO highlights its role in botany, medicine and plant exchange. Its paths offer a way to follow plants into wider networks of knowledge.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage · Botanical Garden, Padua

zh.title: 太极拳：呼吸与圆转动作之间
zh.hook: 不只是一套动作，也是一段传承、教学与生活的历史。
zh.date: 17世纪中叶的起源叙述 · 2020年列入非遗
zh.date_note: 起源范围采用 UNESCO 的描述；用区间而非虚构的精确年份。
story: 太极拳把舒缓圆转的动作、呼吸调节与心意训练放在一起。UNESCO 的介绍将其起源联系到17世纪中叶的河南温县。
此后，不同家族和师承形成了各自的风格，也进入学校和社区。阅读这段故事时，可以分别看动作实践、哲学语言与现代健康研究，不必把三者当成同一类证据。

en.title: Taijiquan: breathing through a circle
en.hook: Movement opens a story of teaching, lineage and everyday practice.
en.date_note: An approximate range follows UNESCO's account, rather than an invented exact founding year.
story: Taijiquan joins relaxed circular movement with breathing and mental cultivation. UNESCO associates its beginnings with mid-seventeenth-century Wenxian in Henan.
Family and teacher lineages developed different styles, alongside later school and community teaching. Movement, philosophical language and modern health research can be explored separately.

zh.title: 切尔西：药师学徒的花园
zh.hook: 学会认植物，曾是成为药师的重要一课。
zh.date_note: 年份来自植物园自身的历史记录。
story: 切尔西药草园由伦敦药师团体于1673年建立，为学徒提供辨认和研究植物的空间。药材不只是柜子里的干燥碎片，也有叶、花、生境和季节。
植物园后来参与种子与知识的交流。它提醒我们：药房史不只是配方史，也包括园艺、教育，以及人们怎样避免认错植物。

en.title: Chelsea: the apothecary apprentice's garden
en.hook: Learning to recognize plants was part of learning to be an apothecary.
en.date_note: The founding year comes from the garden's own history.
story: London's apothecaries founded Chelsea Physic Garden in 1673 as a place to identify and study plants. A medicinal material has leaves, flowers, habitat and seasons before it reaches a cabinet.
The garden became part of seed and knowledge exchange. Pharmacy history is also a history of gardens, education and careful identification.

zh.title: 欧洲温泉城：水如何改变一座城市
zh.place: 欧洲 · 以英国巴斯为导览点
zh.hook: 浴场之外，还有花园、散步道、剧院与旅馆。
zh.date: 约1700年代至1930年代的温泉文化
zh.date_note: 范围对应 UNESCO 描述的欧洲温泉文化发展期；不代表各地泉水或浴场同时出现。
story: 一座温泉城往往围绕水来安排生活：浴场、饮水厅、柱廊，再向外延伸到公园与散步道。照护身体、旅行和社交在这里相遇。
UNESCO 的跨国遗产项目包括七个国家的十一座城镇，呈现约18世纪初至1930年代的发展。这是城市文化史的比较入口，不是对所有温泉疗效的统一背书。

en.title: Spa towns: how water shapes a city
en.hook: Beyond the baths lie gardens, promenades, theatres and hotels.
en.date_note: The period concerns a cultural development, not simultaneous origins of springs or baths.
story: In a spa town, water organizes more than bathing. Pump rooms and colonnades connect with gardens, promenades and places of social life.
UNESCO's serial property includes eleven towns in seven countries and records a cultural development from the early eighteenth century to the 1930s. It is not a blanket endorsement of medical claims.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage · Great Spa Towns of Europe

zh.title: 人宠之间的联系，成为一个研究问题
zh.hook: “和动物在一起感觉更好”，怎样从观察走向正式项目？
zh.date_note: 这是机构里程碑，不是人与动物相伴的起源。
story: 1977年，Delta Foundation 在波特兰建立。它的创办者希望把人和动物互动中的观察，转化成可以研究的问题，而不只停留在动人的个人故事。
这个组织后来更名为 Delta Society，再成为 Pet Partners。对今天的读者，关键区别是：日常宠物陪伴、志愿探访和有专业目标的动物辅助干预，并不是同一种服务。

en.title: The human–animal bond becomes a research question
en.hook: How does a personal experience become an organized field of inquiry?
en.date_note: An institutional milestone, not the beginning of human–animal companionship.
story: The Delta Foundation was formed in Portland in 1977. Its founders wanted observations about human–animal interaction to become research questions, not only compelling anecdotes.
The organization later became Delta Society and then Pet Partners. Everyday companionship, volunteer visits and professionally directed interventions remain different kinds of activity.

zh.title: 森林浴：把注意力重新交给树林
zh.place: 日本 · 赤泽自然休养林
zh.hook: 不是赶路或打卡，而是留意光、声音、空气与脚下的路。
zh.date_note: 1982年指现代术语与推广活动；人类亲近自然的历史远早于此。
story: 日本林野厅在1982年提出森林浴概念，将进入森林、感受自然作为一种容易理解的活动。赤泽自然休养林也与当年的早期活动相关。
它让人把注意力从完成任务转回环境：树影、风声、空气与步行的感受。这里展示的是活动史与体验语境，具体健康结果仍应按研究问题分别考察。

en.title: Forest bathing: giving attention back to the trees
en.hook: Notice light, sound, air and the ground, rather than completing a checklist.
en.date_note: 1982 dates the modern term and promotion, not humanity's first encounter with nature.
story: Japan's Forestry Agency proposed shinrin-yoku in 1982 as an approachable way to spend time in forests. Akasawa is associated with early activities that year.
The practice invites attention to the surrounding environment rather than performance. Its cultural history and specific health research questions should be explored separately.

zh.title: Nuad Thai：从生活照护到专业传承
zh.hook: 看一种手法传统如何被记录、教学和重新组织。
zh.date_note: 1985年是 UNESCO 提及的复兴项目年份，绝不是泰式按摩起源年。
story: Nuad Thai 是泰国传统身体照护的一部分。它的实践和解释来自当地医学与生活文化，也通过教学和传承持续变化。
UNESCO 提到1985年开展的复兴项目，以及后来逐渐规范的训练。这个故事适合了解知识怎样被保存和传授，不提供可以照着实施的手法教程。

en.title: Nuad Thai: care becomes a teaching tradition
en.hook: Follow how a bodywork tradition is recorded, taught and renewed.
en.date_note: 1985 is a project milestone reported by UNESCO, not the origin of Thai massage.
story: Nuad Thai belongs to Thailand's traditions of bodily care. Its practices and explanations are rooted in local medical and everyday culture.
UNESCO describes a revitalization project beginning in 1985 and the development of training. This introduction follows that transmission without becoming an instruction manual.

zh.title: Kallawaya：安第斯山中的知识旅人
zh.place: 玻利维亚 · 拉巴斯北部地区
zh.hook: 草药知识并不独自存在，而是与旅行、仪式和世界观相连。
zh.date_note: 这里只给出可核查的认可年份；传统的历史远早于此。
story: Kallawaya 的故事来自安第斯地区。UNESCO 描述了流动医者的实践，以及植物、矿物和动物来源材料知识与仪式世界观之间的联系。
因此，读者应先认识社区和历史，而不是把其中的知识直接拆成可商业复制的配方。地图使用区域导览点，不揭示神圣地点或受保护的操作细节。

en.title: Kallawaya: travelling knowledge in the Andes
en.hook: Plant knowledge is connected with travel, ritual and a worldview.
en.date_note: These are verifiable recognition dates. The tradition is much older.
story: UNESCO describes Kallawaya itinerant healers and the connections between knowledge of plants, minerals, animal materials and ritual worldviews.
Begin with community and history, rather than extracting a commercial recipe. This map uses a regional navigation point and does not disclose sacred locations or protected details.

sources.title: UNESCO · Andean cosmovision of the Kallawaya

zh.title: 吠陀吟诵：记忆如何住在声音里
zh.hook: 在录音与印刷之前，声音也能保存知识。
zh.date: 2008年列入 UNESCO 代表作名录
zh.date_note: 地图锚点是列入名录的时间，不把古老传统误写成现代发明。
story: 吠陀吟诵是一种与文本、仪式和日常传承紧密相连的口述传统。它的意义不仅在于旋律，也在于知识如何被记住、重复和教给下一代。
可以通过官方纪录影像观察传授方式。宗教意义与吟诵体验值得理解，但这不等于某种音频具有已经确证的通用医疗功效。

en.title: Vedic chanting: memory lives in sound
en.hook: Before recordings and print, the voice could preserve knowledge.
en.date_note: The anchor dates recognition, not the invention of this ancient tradition.
story: Vedic chanting is an oral tradition connected with texts, ritual and everyday transmission. Its story concerns not only melody but how knowledge is remembered and taught.
Official documentary material shows aspects of that transmission. Religious meaning and lived experience do not establish a universal medical effect for an audio recording.

zh.title: 针与灸：两种不同的身体实践
zh.hook: 针刺与艾灸常被并称，但材料、操作与风险并不相同。
zh.date_note: 2010年是文化遗产认可时间；北京仅作国家级导览点，不是起源断言。
story: 针刺和艾灸都处于中医知识与传承体系中，但不应当被视为一种操作。前者涉及针具，后者涉及艾草等材料形成的热刺激。
从小白视角，先区分实践、传统解释和专业训练，再继续看研究资料。非遗认可说明文化与传承价值，不是对所有治疗主张的临床认可。

en.title: Needles and moxa: two different practices
en.hook: Acupuncture and moxibustion share a tradition, not an identical procedure.
en.date_note: 2010 is a heritage milestone. Beijing is a national navigation point, not a claimed birthplace.
story: Acupuncture and moxibustion belong to traditions of Chinese medicine but involve different materials and procedures: needles in one case, heat associated with moxa in the other.
Begin by separating practice, traditional explanation and professional training. Heritage recognition is not clinical approval of every treatment claim.

zh.title: 摩洛哥坚果油：一棵树与女性的手艺
zh.place: 摩洛哥 · 西南部 Arganeraie
zh.hook: 一瓶植物油，连接树木、劳动、家庭与地方生活。
zh.date_note: 锚点为非遗认可年份；不是这种植物或制油方法的出现时间。
story: 摩洛哥坚果树周围形成了一套制油知识。UNESCO 特别记录了女性在制作和代际传授中的角色，以及油在当地烹饪、照护和美容文化中的使用。
把它放进芳香与植物图鉴时，要先辨清材料：摩洛哥坚果油属于脂肪油，不是蒸馏得到的精油。相似的瓶子里，可能是完全不同的东西。

en.title: Argan: a tree and the work of women's hands
en.hook: A bottle of plant oil connects trees, labour, families and local life.
en.date_note: A recognition date, not the first appearance of the plant or oil-making technique.
story: Argan oil-making is a body of local knowledge. UNESCO highlights women's roles in production and transmission, alongside culinary, care and cosmetic uses in local culture.
Material identity matters: argan oil is a fatty oil, not a distilled essential oil. Similar bottles can contain very different types of material.

zh.title: 瑜伽：从一个姿势，走进更大的传统
zh.place: 印度 · 瑞诗凯诗导览点
zh.hook: 体式只是入口，背后还有呼吸、冥想、吟诵与师承。
zh.date_note: 2016年是国际认可时间，不是瑜伽的起源年。
story: UNESCO 对瑜伽的介绍并不只列出姿势，也包括呼吸、冥想、吟诵及其哲学背景。不同练习并不总以相同目的进行。
师徒传授、修习场所和现代学校都是知识流动的路径。对初次接触者，最有帮助的是先辨认具体练习及其语境，而不是把所有瑜伽当作一种疗法。

en.title: Yoga: a posture opens onto a larger tradition
en.hook: Beyond postures lie breathing, meditation, chanting and lineages of teaching.
story: UNESCO's account includes posture, breathing, meditation, chanting and philosophical context. Not every practice is performed for the same purpose.
Teacher–pupil relationships, places of study and modern institutions all transmit knowledge. For a newcomer, the useful first step is identifying a particular practice and its context.

zh.title: 藏医药浴：水、草药与地方知识
zh.place: 中国 · 藏族文化地区
zh.hook: 同样是“浴”，温泉、草药水与蒸汽背后的语境各不相同。
zh.date_note: 年份对应非遗认可；地图坐标为拉萨区域导览点，不标示具体神圣泉址。
story: Lum 药浴属于藏医药 Sowa Rigpa 的知识和实践。UNESCO 的记录涉及天然温泉、草药水和蒸汽，以及当地理解自然与身体的传统模型。
这些模型应按文化知识来呈现，而不是悄悄替换成现代生理学事实。读者可以比较不同地区的浴文化，但不应把一种浴法的研究结果套用到另一种。

en.title: Lum bathing: water, herbs and local knowledge
en.hook: Springs, herbal water and steam belong to distinct local contexts.
en.date_note: A heritage date. The Lhasa-area pin is representative and does not reveal a sacred spring.
story: Lum medicinal bathing belongs to Sowa Rigpa knowledge and practice. UNESCO records natural hot springs, herbal water and steam alongside traditional models of nature and the body.
Those models are presented as cultural knowledge, not relabelled as modern physiology. Evidence for one bathing intervention cannot automatically be applied to another.

zh.title: 芬兰桑拿：不只是洗浴的一间房
zh.place: 芬兰 · 赫尔辛基导览点
zh.hook: 蒸汽、休息与家庭传承，共同组成一种生活文化。
zh.date_note: 现代认可年份，不代表桑拿传统始于2020年。
story: 在芬兰桑拿文化中，水与热石形成的蒸汽、共同休息，以及家庭中的传授都很重要。UNESCO 将它描述为生活与身份的一部分，而不只是清洁身体的设施。
比较桑拿、温泉与药浴时，可以先观察空间、材料与人与人的关系。文化相似不等于风险相同，体验是否适宜仍取决于具体条件。

en.title: Finnish sauna: more than a room for bathing
en.hook: Steam, rest and family transmission form a living culture.
en.date_note: A modern recognition date, not the beginning of sauna culture.
story: Finnish sauna culture includes steam from water and hot stones, shared rest and transmission within families. UNESCO describes its place in everyday life and identity.
Compare the spaces, materials and relationships of sauna, hot springs and herbal baths. Cultural similarities do not mean identical risks or suitability.

zh.title: Rongoā Māori：照护人，也照护关系
zh.place: Aotearoa 新西兰 · 毛利社区
zh.hook: 植物只是入口，人与土地、社区和知识的关系同样重要。
zh.date_note: 年份来自新西兰健康研究委员会的项目记录；不是毛利疗愈传统的起源。
story: Rongoā Māori 不能只翻译成一张草药清单。2020年新西兰健康研究委员会支持的项目，关注这种传统中人与人、人与环境的疗愈关系。
研究采用毛利方法论，通过讨论与个案来理解实践。网站只介绍公开材料，不把社区知识视为可以自由复制的配方，也不发布私密采集地点。

en.title: Rongoā Māori: caring for relationships
en.hook: Plants open a wider story about people, land, community and knowledge.
en.date_note: This dates a Health Research Council project, not the origin of the tradition.
story: Rongoā Māori is not simply a herbal checklist. A 2020 Health Research Council project examines the relationships between people and environment within this system of care.

The research uses kaupapa Māori approaches, discussion and case studies. This atlas introduces public material without treating community knowledge as freely reusable recipes or exposing private gathering places.

sources.title: Health Research Council of New Zealand · Te Ao Rauropi
